documents.source: owner-supplied official Kalshi fee schedule, attached to the 2026-09-23 integration directive (docs/owner/2026-09-23-integration-production-directive.md); the owner downloaded it (kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf answers automated requests with a bot checkpoint, see ATTEMPTS_2026-09-23.md)
documents.effective_text: Last updated and effective: July 7, 2026 (footer of every page)

page_references.2: Trading Fees: general taker fee = round up(M x 0.07 x C x P x (1-P)), M default 1; Maker Fees: round up(M x 0.0175 x C x P x (1-P)), M default 0; round up = fee + positionCost rounded to a centicent; upcoming changes at kalshi.com/fee-schedule; the general terms apply apart from specific products with their own schedule
page_references.3: no settlement fee; no membership fee; ACH/wire/debit/crypto/alternate-rail deposit and withdrawal fees; FCM customers may pay FCM fees
page_references.4-5: General Trading Fees Table (display, rounded up to the cent); transcribed in pdf_table_rows.json
page_references.6-11: Non-Standard Fees (series, maker multiplier, taker multiplier); transcribed in pdf_nonstandard_series.json; KXHIGHNY is not listed
page_references.12: Perpetual futures fee tiers (not applicable to event contracts)

documents.text_layer_note: the PDF text layer of pages 8-11 repeats and garbles some rows (for example a missing multiplier for KXNASDAQ100Y and KXMLBNL); transcriptions follow the rendered pages

documents.observed: trade fee rounded up to $0.000001; direct-member balances aligned to $0.0001, non-direct to $0.01; rounding fee; per-order accumulator rebates in balance-precision increments
